summary: OpenAI describes an NEJM AI study in which researchers used its o3 Deep Research model to reanalyze 376 previously unsolved rare-disease genetic cases, surfacing evidence-linked leads that led to 18 confirmed diagnoses after expert and clinical review.

practices.reason: The described design of using the model as an 'explanation-first reasoning layer' on top of an existing pipeline, with structured input packets and multi-reviewer consensus, is a concrete architecture pattern a team could adapt for expert-review-augmented workflows.
practices.quote: researchers designed the workflow so that the model acted as an explanation-first reasoning layer on top of existing genomic pipelines.
